submission.body:
There was one defect left. `src/decision/commands.ts` line 15 still imported `WorkOrderId` from `../domain/primitives`. That type no longer exists there, so the file's uses of `TaskOrderId` were unresolved. I changed the import to `TaskOrderId`.

A repo-wide search now finds `WorkOrderId` only in `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/migration.md`. Both mention the old name as history, so I left them. All code references use `TaskOrderId`, including the definition in `primitives.ts` and the uses in `ids.ts`, `artifacts.ts`, `run-event.ts`, `run-record.ts`, `operator-projections.ts` and the test snapshot-builder.

I did not run `tsc` or `bun test`. There is no `node_modules` in the workspace, and there is no git history to diff against. The check is by text search only.

I left identifiers such as `workOrderIdFor`, `work_order_id` and `executorOperationIdForWorkOrder`, and the `work-orders` URLs in prompts, unchanged. They are outside a rename of the type alone.
